text: On May 28, 2026, Toronto and East York Community Council directed Transportation Services to review options to install safe pedestrian crosswalks on Winona Drive, between Holland Park Avenue and Glenhurst Avenue, and to report back with recommendations to the July 8, 2026 meeting of Toronto and East York Community Council. The purpose of this report is to summarize the findings of the review and outline locations where new pedestrian crosswalk markings may be installed.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Received the report (June 17, 2026) from the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation Services for information.
